text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Brian's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Will you two be okay? I haven't asked
you to
watch the store in quite some
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It won't be a problem, Mother. We've
helped out enough times in the past not
to forget. We are
the daughters of shop
owners, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Brian's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that is reassuring to hear! Now
then, your father and I will be out
paying visits to guests
attending our
store's anniversary party.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The anniversary of our store's founding...
We need to run this place without
issues, so that our
parents can focus on
the party preparations!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the "54th Generation." This
Japanese sake is notoriously difficult to
acquire. I must pack it
carefully so as not
to damage the bottle...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe another layer. But what if it
were to fall and get run over by a
passing truck? I should
wrap it three
more times to be safe...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. Seriously, Sis? What's with that

bubble-wrapped monstrosity you've got
there?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What, the highway is congested?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Our transport route uses public roads,
which means an ever-present risk of
traffic. I should
plan a backup route...
and a second backup.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm, this road looks quite narrow. It
could be bad if an elderly citizen were
also walking along it. I'll take that into
consideration for backup route
twelve...

text_block_list.name: Delivery Worker
text_block_list.text:
Um, Hayahide? When do you think we
can get
these deliveries out?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! Oh no, look at the time! Per my

calculations, you'll be late to the last
delivery
stop by a few minutes...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Do not fret! I have devised a plan. You
can leave
it to me!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"And we will revise our delivery flow to
ensure there will be no delays in the
future. Representative of the Heiwa
Liquor Store—Biwa
Hayahide."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...This is our apology letter. I have also
prepared
letters for your husband, your
father, and your
grandchild.

text_block_list.name: Inn Proprietress
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how kind of you. But... I think
you should
take a look over there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why are the beer crates here?!

text_block_list.name: Inn Proprietress
text_block_list.text:
Well you see, young Brian delivered
these on foot
not so long ago.

text_block_list.name: Inn Proprietress
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you sisters haven't changed a bit.
Ah! Do
you remember that time?

text_block_list.name: Inn Proprietress
text_block_list.text:
It was when Brian started coming to our
archery
dojo...

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian,
I've brought you a first aid kit. Oh,
and a yellow hat should help you stand
out at street
crossings. Wait here, I'll go get it.

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You want me to take even more?! Sis, I've gotta get going already...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I remember those days. My worries
would give
way to more worries, which
only made Brian late
for her lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while looking for reference
materials in
the library, I spot Biwa
Hayahide eagerly poring
over a book.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ninety percent of our worries do not
actually
occur in reality. Therefore, it is
important to correct such cognitive
bias." Hmm, interesting.
